Seamless 360 degree cylindrical panorama strip, a skybox backdrop for a stylised video game with the stylised realism of a modern Nintendo golf game: believable light and atmosphere, bold saturated colour, slightly painterly. A perfectly straight level horizon line runs across the whole image at one fifth of the height from the bottom edge. Below the horizon only a sea of jungle canopy under mist. Above it golden hour in the tropics: a humid amber and green-gold sky, towering thunderheads lit orange and rose, the sun low in the left third behind bright mist. All the way round the horizon stand steep jungle-covered limestone karst mountains and ridges in layers, each layer paler in the mist, with bands of low cloud lying between them, reaching up to one fifth of the image height. No buildings. No foreground objects, no people, no animals, no text, no logos, no real landmarks, no lens flare streaks, no vignette, no frame. The left edge and the right edge match exactly so the strip wraps around seamlessly.
